'''One-humped camels''' are [[creature]]s who can be found in [[desert]]s, often seen being used as pack animals by [[dwarf]] and [[human]] [[merchant]]s - like other herbivorous livestock, they require a sizeable [[pasture]] to survive. One-humped camel calves need two years to grow to their full adult size, and they only live for a maximum of 10-20 years.

They may be [[butcher]]ed for a good amount of returns, or assigned as fairly valuable [[pet]]s. Female one-humped camels produce [[milk]], which can be [[cook]]ed or processed into [[cheese]].

One-humped camels are also known as dromedaries, and are not to be confused with (nor bred with) the [[two-humped camel]], which is a different species. 

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] one-humped camels for their ''hump''.
